title: Vulnerability Triage: What to Fix First

scenes.say: Your scan just flagged hundreds of critical issues. How do you decide what to fix first?

First, tackle systems open to the internet. Next, look for vulnerabilities with known exploits. Then, use the CVSS score to sort by severity. Finally, group findings by fix—one patch can solve dozens.

scenes.label: Waves
scenes.sub: Schedule fixes in batches, document exceptions.
scenes.say: Roll out patches in waves through change management. If you can't fix everything, document exceptions and set a deadline.

scenes.question: What's the best triage approach?
scenes.wrong: Fix the highest CVSS scores first.
scenes.right: Start with internet-facing and known exploited, then use CVSS. Group by fix and document exceptions.
scenes.say: Don't just chase the highest scores. Think about exposure and real-world exploits first.
